chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Musa ibn Bukayr, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about disbelief (Kufr) and association (Shirk), which of the two is earlier? He said to me: 'Have I not agreed with you to debate with the people?' I said: 'Hisham ibn Salim instructed me to ask you about that.' So he said to me: 'Disbelief is earlier, and it is denial.'
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Except for Iblis. He refused and was arrogant, and he was one of the unbelievers.'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Kufr and Shirk and which came first?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes that fundamental denial (Kufr) precedes polytheism (Shirk), defining Kufr as the initial act of rejection. This theological hierarchy is illustrated by Iblis, whose primary sin was disobedience and denial of the divine command before his arrogance manifested as shirk. The hadith underscores that shirk is a derivative state rooted in the primary condition of kufr.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Musa Bin Bukeyr who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassanasws about the disbelief (Kufr) and the association (Shirk), which of the two was earlier?’ So heasws said to me: ‘Iasws have not agreed with you to debate with the people’. I said, ‘Hisham Bin Salim instructed me that I ask youasws about that’. So heasws said to me: ‘The disbelief (Kufr) occurred earlier and it is the denial.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [2:34] except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant, and he was one of the unbelievers’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Musa ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “

Once I asked abu al-Hassan (a.s.) about disbelief and al-Shirk (paganism) as to which is before. The Imam said to me, ‘I have not experienced your involvement in polemics among the people.’ I then said, ‘Hisham ibn Salim has ordered me to ask you this question.’ The Imam said, ‘Disbelief is before and it is denial and rejection.
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has said, . . except Iblis (Satan) who abstained out of pride, and so he became one of those who deny the truth.’” [2:34]
